repos_data.description: Official MCP server for Frihet ERP — 157 tools for AI-powered invoicing, tax & e-invoicing compliance (VeriFactu, TicketBAI, Facturae), banking, CRM, HR/payroll & POS. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Antigravity, Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI — and any MCP-compatible client.
